summary: 1 major finding: the cycle index artifact is present but does not point to any cycle or explicitly record a terminal state, so it cannot serve as the documented active-cycle pointer.

findings.title: Active-cycle pointer is empty, so omitted cycle paths cannot be resolved
findings.details: [.spec/cycle_index.md:5](C:/Users/nalum/project/workflow-templates/.spec/cycle_index.md#L5) defines the table schema, but the file stops after the separator row and never records an active cycle entry. The repo workflow defines `.spec/cycle_index.md` as the active-cycle pointer used when a command omits the cycle path, and completion rules also imply an explicit terminal state such as `DONE` rather than a blank table. In its current state, the artifact is syntactically present but semantically unusable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exactly one row identifying the current cycle (`Cycle ID`, `Directory`, `Branch`, `Status`, `Summary`) or replace the blank table with an explicit terminal state if the repository intentionally has no active cycle.
